## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. State the relevant ROADMAP
identifier or existing issue and whether the feature is Implemented,
Experimental, Planned or Not supported.

## Validation

- [ ] Frozen installation
- [ ] Lint and format check
- [ ] Typecheck, tests and build
- [ ] Documentation and preventive secret checks
- [ ] Dependency audit (`pnpm audit --audit-level high`)
- [ ] Staged diff reviewed for sensitive files and values

List any unexecuted checks and why. Explain meaningful security implications,
compatibility limits and whether a Changeset is needed.
